lessons.title: Chickpea and spinach curry
learn: Cooking spices in oil to wake them up
Simmering a sauce until it thickens
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves and a thumb of ginger, grated

steps.text: Soften the onion in the oil over a medium heat

timer.doneness: until soft and golden at the edges

steps.text: Stir in the garlic, ginger and curry powder
steps.tip: Keep stirring. Spices burn quickly and turn bitter.

steps.text: Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer

timer.doneness: until the sauce has thickened and coats the back of a spoon

steps.text: Taste, add salt and serve with rice or chapati

lessons.title: One-pan tomato pasta
learn: Cooking pasta in its own sauce
Turning starchy water into a glossy sauce
ingredients: A handful of basil, grated parmesan and salt

steps.text: Put everything except the basil and parmesan into a wide pan with 1 tsp salt
steps.detail: Lay the pasta flat. Snap it in half if it doesn't fit.

steps.text: Bring it to the boil over a high heat

timer.doneness: until it's bubbling hard all over

steps.text: Keep it boiling, turning the pasta with tongs every minute or so

timer.doneness: until the pasta is tender and the water has become a glossy sauce

steps.tip: If it dries out before the pasta is done, add a splash of water.

steps.text: Stir in the basil and parmesan, taste for salt and serve

lessons.title: Sausage and veg traybake
learn: Giving potatoes a head start in the oven
Knowing when a sausage is cooked through

timer.doneness: until the oven is fully hot

steps.text: Toss the potatoes with half the oil and a pinch of salt in a large tray and roast

timer.doneness: until the edges start to turn golden

steps.text: Add the sausages, onions, peppers, rosemary and the rest of the oil, toss and roast
steps.detail: Turn the sausages halfway through so they brown all over.

timer.doneness: until the sausages are browned, firm and no longer pink in the middle

steps.tip: Not sure? Cut the thickest one open, or check it reads 75°C on a thermometer.

steps.text: Give everything a stir and serve straight from the tray

lessons.title: Lemon garlic chicken thighs
learn: Crisping chicken skin from a cold pan
Checking chicken is cooked all the way to the bone
ingredients: 1 lemon, half sliced and half juiced
1 tbsp oil, salt and black pepper

steps.text: Pat the chicken dry and season it all over
steps.tip: Dry skin crisps. Wet skin steams.

steps.text: Lay the thighs skin side down in a large cold pan with the oil, then set it over a medium heat

timer.doneness: until the skin is deep golden and crisp and lets go of the pan

steps.text: Turn the thighs over, add the garlic, lemon slices and stock, cover and simmer

timer.doneness: until the juices run clear and the thickest part reads 75°C, with no pink near the bone

steps.tip: No thermometer? Cut into the thickest thigh next to the bone and look.

steps.text: Take the lid off, add the green beans around the chicken and squeeze in the lemon juice

timer.doneness: until the beans are bright green and just tender

steps.text: Spoon the pan juices over the chicken and serve
